description: This file contains test classes for versioning strategies in Orleans grains, testing various version selector and compatibility strategies, and verifying grain activation behaviors under different conditions.

classes.name: MinimumVersionTests
classes.description: Tests ensuring that the minimum version of grains is always activated, even after new silo deployments.

classes.name: LatestVersionTests
classes.description: Tests ensuring that the latest version of grains is activated, and verifying upgrade behaviors with pending requests.

classes.name: AllVersionsCompatibleTests
classes.description: Tests ensuring that compatible versions do not trigger automatic upgrades, verifying behavior with and without pending requests.

classes.name: RandomCompatibleVersionTests
classes.description: Distributed activation tests across multiple grain versions, verifying random selection within compatible strategies.

methods.name: AlwaysCreateActivationWithMinimumVersion
methods.description: Test method ensuring only minimum version grains are activated post silo deployment.

methods.name: AlwaysCreateActivationWithLatestVersion
methods.description: Test method ensuring the latest version grains are activated post silo deployment.

methods.name: UpgradeProxyCallNoPendingRequest
methods.description: Verifies that a proxy call prompts upgrade and activation when no request is pending.

methods.name: UpgradeProxyCallWithPendingRequest
methods.description: Verifies that a proxy call with a pending request prompts upgrade and activation.

methods.name: DoNotUpgradeProxyCallNoPendingRequest
methods.description: Ensures that compatible versions do not trigger upgrades when no requests are pending.

methods.name: DoNotUpgradeProxyCallWithPendingRequest
methods.description: Ensures that compatible versions do not trigger upgrades even when requests are pending.

methods.name: CreateActivationWithBothVersion
methods.description: Creates multiple grains to statistically verify distribution across various versions with random compatible strategies.
